say:1:1630211001:1.text: I've been in a slump ever since I flunked the first round. Can't bring myself to care about anything...
say:1:1630211001:1.source_cn: 我从第一场选拔赛失利后就一直很低落，做什么都没心情……
say:1:1630211001:1.male: I've been in a slump ever since I flunked the first round. Can't bring myself to care about anything...
say:1:1630211001:1.female: I've been in a slump ever since I flunked the first round. Can't bring myself to care about anything...

say:2:1630211002:1.text: Professor Fernando gave me a talking-to. Said I needed to figure out what being a good mage actually means.
say:2:1630211002:1.source_cn: 费尔南多老师骂了我一顿，叫我自己好好想想什么是真正厉害...
say:2:1630211002:1.male: Professor Fernando gave me a talking-to. Said I needed to figure out what being a good mage actually means.
say:2:1630211002:1.female: Professor Fernando gave me a talking-to. Said I needed to figure out what being a good mage actually means.

say:3:1630211003:1.text: I think he was just trying to tell me that being a court mage isn't the finish line.
say:3:1630211003:1.source_cn: 不论真正的答案是什么，我想老师肯定是想告诉我宫廷魔法师...
say:3:1630211003:1.male: I think he was just trying to tell me that being a court mage isn't the finish line.
say:3:1630211003:1.female: I think he was just trying to tell me that being a court mage isn't the finish line.

say:4:1630211004:1.source_cn: 我不能再这样低迷下去了。
